{"narrative": "I am filing this report because today XX/XX/2020 I tried to refinance my car and I was unable to do so because there were many accounts reflecting badly on my credit report. I did not benefit anything from any of these accounts such as money, goods, services or any other benefit nor did I ever make any payments towards these accounts. I don't know who is responsible for opening these accounts in my name without my permission buy I have already filed a police report. I do not have any written/verbal contract with any of these companies and I did not allow them to run or access my credit information."}
